03 · Content provenance language

Name the origin

User-authoredWritten directly by the consultant.
ImportedReceived from an external system or file.
InheritedCarried from an earlier stage with source attached.
ComputedCalculated from explicit inputs and formula.
AI-suggestedGenerated proposal awaiting human acceptance.
ValidatedReviewed and confirmed against evidence.
SupersededPreserved earlier value replaced by a later one.
04 · Agent handoff

Content-system brief

Write interface copy for a case-management product. VOICE - precise - calm - non-promotional - evidence-aware - neutral about Proceed and No-Go - explicit about consequences DISTINGUISH User-authored, Imported, Inherited, Computed, AI-suggested, Validated, Superseded. MESSAGE RULES - Name the object or action that failed. - State whether user work was preserved. - Explain why the condition matters. - Give one concrete next action. - Do not use generic phrases such as “Something went wrong,” “No data,” or “Are you sure?” - AI suggestions must say they are suggestions and whether a human accepted them. - No-Go copy must describe closure as a legitimate outcome. - Provenance labels should name source stage, author, and date where useful.
